title: Role of Predators
text: Predators keep prey populations in check. When predators are removed, their prey populations typically grow because fewer individuals are being eaten.

title: What Do Snakes Eat?
text: Snakes prey on frogs and may also prey on mice directly. If snakes are removed, what happens to the animals they were eating?

title: The Answer
text: With fewer predators hunting them, mice will have higher survival rates. Initially, the mouse population will INCREASE.
